entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: A rebel leader on Rath, daughter of Starke il-Vec, imprisoned by Volrath and killed by a Phyrexian bomb on Dominaria.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Takara's father, forced to obey Volrath to free her; killed by Volrath in Mercadia.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler of the Stronghold who imprisoned Takara to manipulate Starke, and shapeshifted into her likeness.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane on which Takara led rebels.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's fortress with dungeons on Rath.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship that came to Rath to free Captain Sisay.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, imprisoned on Rath.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Elf lord who surrendered to the Stronghold, freed himself, and freed Takara.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: Rebel who escaped to Dominaria injured and stayed with Takara and Eladamri.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Having turned against her Phyrexian makers, she revealed a portal device to the rebels.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Subject of the Coronation after which the situation seemed hopeless.

entities.name: Dream Halls
entities.description: Place within the Stronghold where the rebels were pinned down.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane to which the Weatherlight fled, where Volrath killed Starke.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Destination Eladamri chose for the portal.

entities.name: Llanowar elves
entities.description: Elves the heroes tried to convince of the coming invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war that began on Dominaria while the heroes warned the Llanowar elves.

events.summary: Takara is captured and imprisoned by Volrath, used as a tool to manipulate her father Starke.
events.quote: she could be used as a tool to manipulate her father

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew overlooks Takara's cell; Volrath, shapeshifted as Takara, stows away and later kills Starke in Mercadia.
events.quote: Once in Mercadia, Volrath killed Starke

events.summary: Eladamri surrenders to let rebels sneak into the fortress; Greven tortures him until he frees himself.
events.quote: Eladamri held out until Greven was called away

events.summary: Eladamri frees Takara, who guides them through the Stronghold; they join Lin Sivvi and are pinned down in the Dream Halls.
events.quote: He quickly freed her, then had her use her knowledge of the Stronghold's layout

events.summary: Belbe reveals her portal device; Eladamri sends Sivvi through and Takara dashes through the portal to escape.
events.quote: Takara dashed through the portal to safety

events.summary: On Dominaria Takara travels with Sivvi and Eladamri warning people of the invasion.
events.quote: warning people of the coming invasion

events.summary: Dying of the plague, Takara tries to guide elves to underground caves and is instantly killed by a Phyrexian bomb.
events.quote: she was hit by a Phyrexian bomb and instantly killed

relations.quote: She was the daughter of Starke il
until she was captured and imprisoned by Volrath
Once in Mercadia, Volrath killed Starke
